source_observations: A narrow, dim and soft bathroom mirror selfie has one adult-presenting figure whose eyes, nose and mouth are hidden behind an upright black phone and splayed holding fingers.

The crown intersects the top edge; the head and upper torso project to viewer-left of hips which crowd the right edge. The viewer-right shoulder is higher. A shallow sink/counter band intersects the upper thighs at the bottom.
Two long dark braids and an uneven fringe surround the obscured face; the viewer-left braid hangs lower.
A pale muted blue fitted cropped tank, a relatively smooth fine knitted pale cardigan dropped below both shoulders, and dark loose piped shorts establish the clothing silhouette.
The high left note is a comparatively large pale yellow square. The towel rail has dark detailed hardware; counter toiletries are cropped at lower left. The right background is near black.
delivered_render_observations: One adult-presenting figure holds an upright dark phone with splayed fingers concealing the eyes, nose and mouth. Two dark braids, an uneven fringe, a raised viewer-right arm and a lowered opposite arm are visible.
The pale blue cropped tank, dropped cardigan, dark piped drawstring shorts, towel at left, small wall note, dark right background and partial foreground basin are recognizable.

The figure is more centered and upright; the projected head/upper-torso to hips offset is smaller, with more gap between hips and the right edge. The crown has a small amount of visible headroom instead of the source clip.
The cardigan is a bulkier, highly textured knit with prominent stitches. Hair strands, clothing texture and skin detail are more resolved, with an added visible grain pattern.
The note is smaller and darker, and towel-rail hardware is simplified. The tank and cardigan are dimmer and grayer in displayed value. The midriff gap is larger and the navel is visible.
